stock_recipes.ten_percent: 0.200 g undiluted material + 1.800 g same ethanol = 2.000 g stock
stock_recipes.one_percent: 0.200 g homogeneous 10% w/w stock + 1.800 g ethanol = 2.000 g 1% stock
stock_recipes.point_one_percent: 0.200 g homogeneous 1% w/w stock + 1.800 g ethanol = 2.000 g 0.1% stock
stock_recipes.tiny_power_material_intermediate: Where desired, make 0.200 g of 10% intermediate from 0.020 g material + 0.180 g ethanol, then serially dilute; do not count drops

protocol.substrate: Same blotter type; no skin test is authorized here
protocol.application: Use the same predeclared measured blotter deposit; do not infer spray equality
protocol.blinding: Random three-digit codes; keep key separate until impressions recorded. Self-preparation may reduce blinding.
questions: Uncued identity: pear, apple, tropical, floral, other, not perceived, cannot determine
Which do you like? Allow tie and cannot determine
At comparable perceived intensity, is the fruit more dimensional or merely stronger/sweeter?
Does the fruit remain recognizable at 45 minutes and 4 hours?
Shampoo, leafy, peach/coconut, overt floral, musk, or dry-wood drift?
protocol.repeat: Screen once; repeat the best informative comparison on a different day before scaling. No population claim.
stop_conditions: Clouding, precipitation, leakage, or suspected stock error
Unclear pear/apple identity or domination by another fruit/floral/base
Any adverse response; no further exposure
No benefit over simple control: remove layers, do not increase ingredient count
